# ORNIVA

> ORNIVA is a digital growth studio that builds websites, CRM, first-party customer data and creative content (images, video and voice, including AI-generated media) for growing businesses. A venture by RAZZO and Sotres.

Tagline: Get seen. Get chosen. Get booked.

## Packages

- Launch, from $2,500: a conversion-focused website (up to 6 pages, copywriting, mobile-first design, SEO basics, lead form and booking, analytics), live one week after brief sign-off.
- Growth System, from $4,500 plus $300 per month: everything in Launch plus CRM setup, a lead magnet, automated email and SMS follow-up, a monthly report and care.
- Content Studio, custom quote: monthly images, short videos and voiceovers by ORNIVA Content Studio.
- E-commerce and payments, custom quote: online stores, subscriptions and digital products.

## Data

ORNIVA builds lead magnets and consent-based customer databases that clients own, then activates them through email, SMS, WhatsApp and smarter ads. Contacts opt in, can opt out anytime, and their data is never sold.

## Ownership

Clients own their website, domain, content and customer data.
